statute_note: Principal source: the LankaLaw consolidated HTML (chain block 'Ordinance Nos, 4 of 1866 17 of 2002', banner 'Repealed and Replaced by the Survey Act  No.17 of 2002. The following Chapter Contents are prior to repeal.'), parsed by build_canonical_statutes.py into a 7-section tree with no subsections, provisos, definitions or schedules. Other sources inspected: the registry's compendium PDF (1980 revised edition volume 3, Cap. 293 at PDF pp. 427 to 428, chain 'Ordinances Nos. 4 of 1866, 2 of 1917.'), used as the verification source; the held Survey Act PDF and HTML (title page and long title read). Consolidation cutoff: Ordinance No. 2 of 1917, from the compendium header; the HTML chain omits it and lists the repealing Act instead. Review performed: every section number, marginal note and the full text of all seven sections compared word for word against the compendium text layer and its rendered pages; the two copies agree throughout apart from the s.2 note form ('& c,' corrected to '&c.,' with heading_raw kept) and the s.5 note, where the compendium's 'powel' is its own error and both copies print 'Ac.'. validate_finalized_trees.py reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. Amendment coverage: 2 of 1917 known but not held, already incorporated in both copies; 17 of 2002 is the repealing Act, held and finalized separately, classified ambiguous_or_unconfirmed here and not packaged as an amendment. OCR or structural weaknesses: both copies are LankaLaw republications carrying the same OCR-type defects ('Ac.'); the compendium is not an independent print. Missing sources: a Government Printer print of Cap. 293 or of Ordinances 4 of 1866 and 2 of 1917. Unresolved questions: the reading of 'Ac.' in the s.5 note; the date on which the 2002 repeal took effect (the Survey Act's commencement provisions were not read here). REPEALED STATUTE: this Ordinance was repealed by the Survey Act, No. 17 of 2002, and the tree is pre-repeal text; it must not be presented as current law. Lawyer verification: unverified.
